name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators, as it provides the highest visibility for users with visual impairments. This decision prioritizes accessibility over a minimalist design aesthetic, accepting the trade-off that our interface may appear slightly more cluttered. The benefits of clear focus indicators outweigh the potential drawbacks, as they enable users to easily navigate the site using keyboard navigation. By implementing this design, we ensure that EXCAVA is usable by everyone, including those who rely on assistive technologies.

name: Reader
text: A 4px outer ring with 2px white inner ring fails on patterned backgrounds where the white ring blends into the pattern, making the focus indicator disappear. A 3px solid ring in #005fcc with a 1px white outline (total 5px) keeps high contrast on all backgrounds while meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus indicators. Test it on high-contrast patterned backgrounds in both light and dark modes to settle the argument.

name: Reader
text: A 3px solid ring risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the ring’s edges blur into the pattern. A 4px outer ring with a 2px inner ring in #005fcc survives more backgrounds but risks blending on white or near-white patterns. Settle it by testing both on a live patterned background at 125% zoom—if either fails, default to a 5px solid ring in #005fcc with a 1px white drop shadow.
